notes: *deal with him as a slave*: the preposition and suffix take *with him*, the rest of the phrase belongs to the verb, headed on the complement *slave* (rules 25, 44).
נֶפֶשׁ takes the indefinite *any* and the partitive מִן takes its own *of*, a present morpheme taking its English before a fused *any of* reading (rules 11, 19).
הַגַּנָּב הַהוּא → *that thief*: the demonstrative pronoun takes the phrase's single determiner and both articles are unrepresented (rule 41).
